schedule.fragment_source: Luis Fernando Verissimo — Comédias da Vida Privada
schedule.prompt: O casal estava casado havia vinte e sete anos sem nunca ter tido uma discussão pública relevante, até a noite em que ele decidiu explicar detalhadamente na mesa do restaurante como se dobrava corretamente um mapa rodoviário. O garçom permaneceu imóvel com a garrafa de vinho suspensa no ar enquanto o silêncio entre os dois adquiriu o peso de uma tempestade antártica prestes a desabar.

schedule.fragment_source: Conto Fantástico — O Relojoeiro de Ouro Preto
schedule.prompt: Na oficina estreita da Ladeira de Santa Efigênia, duzentos relógios de pêndulo, carrilhões franceses e cronômetros de bolso trabalhavam em tempos ligeiramente desencontrados. O velho relojoeiro fechava os olhos no centro daquele enxame de tique-taques de latão e jurava ouvir, nas defasagens microscópicas entre as engrenagens, o próprio respirar do tempo.

schedule.fragment_source: Descrição de Imagem — Sintetizador Modular Buchla e Osciloscópio em Estúdio Escuro
schedule.prompt: Close-up fotográfico de um gabinete de sintetizador modular em um estúdio penumbroso, repleto de potenciômetros prateados, matrizes de pinos luminosos e cabos entrelaçados. Ao lado, a tela verde de fósforo de um osciloscópio analógico desenha figuras de Lissajous em rotação contínua que se dobram e se desdobram em harmônicos complexos.

A Congada é uma manifestação folclórica e religiosa sincrética brasileira que celebra a coroação de reis do Congo em louvor a Nossa Senhora do Rosário e a São Benedito. Encontrada em Minas Gerais, Goiás e São Paulo, envolve desfiles ritmados de ternos de congo e moçambiques, onde gungas de lata amarradas aos tornozelos produzem percussões metálicas e passos cadenciados.

models.artistic_signature: A noise-and-resonator texturalist who favors filtered Pink/White noise, Ringz and DynKlank percussion clusters, and phase-drifting impulse swarms to evoke mechanical or obsessive programmatic imagery. Conceptual metaphors tend to be sharper than the formal architecture built to carry them.
key_strengths: Evocative concept-to-DSP mapping, e.g. accelerating BPF clicks for map-folding, dephased impulse swarms for gears, and a 1.501 FM ratio for Lissajous figures
Effective inharmonic resonator work, with Ringz and DynKlank clusters given per-trigger TRand drift for organic variation
Comfortable live-coding scaffolding using Ndef, Pbindef and Tdef, plus Bus routing, that suits iterative performance
blind_spots: Weak macro-form and tension arcs: the pieces repeatedly settle into static loops, rely on commented-out macros instead of automated evolution, and underscale gestures relative to the stated concept
Narrow synthesis palette of 16 unique UGens dominated by SinOsc and basic filters, with generic CombL/FreeVerb2 spaces and little granular, spectral or dynamics processing

rounds.standout_technique: Accelerating, rising BPF noise clicks mimic obsessive map-folding
rounds.weakness: Storm tension never builds; static loops without macro evolution
rounds.rationale: The code uses clean Ndef plus \set Pbindef routing with t_trig percussive envelopes. It also includes LeakDC on the drone, though the other layers lack it and the gain staging is cautious. Its palette is mostly SinOsc and filtered noise, but the metaphors land well: 27-based durations, near-unison detuned 'couple' voices, compressing paper-fold rhythms, and a 46 Hz sub with icy narrow-band pink noise for the suspended silence. Structurally the material is cyclic and never moves toward the impending Antarctic storm, so the dramatic tension is only implied.

rounds.standout_technique: Phase-offset Impulse swarm with drift-scaled rates creating gear dephasing
rounds.weakness: Fourteen-voice swarm undersells two hundred clocks; xset on functional Ndefs
rounds.rationale: The code shows solid architecture: a limiter on the tail, a dedicated bus, Ndef filter slots, and contrasting Ringz, DynKlank and FM-bell voices. One weakness is that xset on these Ndefs triggers crossfades rather than smooth parameter changes. The drifting impulse swarm and the breathing band-passed noise with beating sines map the prompt's microscopic dephasing and breath of time directly. The timestamped Tdef arc moves clearly from a lone pendulum through accelerating gears to a held-breath climax and a fade-out. The palette stays fairly conventional, and FreeVerb is still in the chain.

rounds.standout_technique: Wavefolding XFade and ratio-1.501 FM evoking Lissajous figures
rounds.weakness: Thin timbral palette; generic CombL plus FreeVerb2 space
rounds.rationale: The architecture is solid. It uses bus-mapped control parameters, separate groups, LeakDC plus a Limiter on the master, robust MIDI device detection, and a two-zone GUI with polling sync. The panic CC also triggers the generic CC loop harmlessly. The voices are modest: detuned VarSaw with fold2 for the cabinet, and near-harmonic sines morphing into 3:2-ish FM for the phosphor zone. The FM loosely maps Lissajous ratio figures, but the patch never exploits stereo X/Y phase relationships or rotating harmonic folding in depth.
